title: Energieerhaltung und Systemarten abrufen
titleEn: Recall energy conservation and system types
description: Die lernende Person kann Energieerhaltung und den auf der Karte beschriebenen Energie- und Materieaustausch offener, geschlossener und isolierter Systeme mithilfe der zugehörigen Lernkarten sicher abrufen.
descriptionEn: The learner can reliably recall energy conservation and the energy and matter exchange of open, closed and isolated systems described on the card using the associated flashcards.

memorySupportSelection.role: Recall of previously taught compact content only. No ordinary competency, source duty, acquisition performance, or Human evidence is certified.
memorySupportSelection.selectionSemantics: Unchanged getSrsFilterTags returns the existing goal: tags because no GK/LK or new selector tag is added. The unchanged card filter uses their OR intersection; actual ordered cards are checked, not inferred from selectedCardIds.
